description.en: Unregisters a character handle from the movement manager system, the counterpart to CMND_CHR_REG_MOVE_MNGR.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Unregister a character from the movement manager
CMND_CHR_DEL_MOVE_MNGR(hTsurugiL2);
